build_transformer: build a DETR Transformer model from argparse args with configurable encoder and decoder layers
create_Transformer: create a Transformer module with d_model, nhead, and configurable encoder and decoder layer counts
run_TransformerEncoder: run the TransformerEncoder forward pass on source tensors with optional padding mask and positional embeddings
run_TransformerDecoder: run the TransformerDecoder forward pass returning intermediate activations from all decoding layers
review_TransformerDecoderLayer: review the TransformerDecoderLayer self-attention and cross-attention with pre-norm and post-norm variants
